card.name: Clinical Pharmacology section cross-reference
card.fires_on: The space or opening parenthesis right before the number 12.3 in a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)]. It appears in drug interaction statements in label text.

modes.label: Gap before 12.3
modes.description: The blank token just after the opening parenthesis in a Clinical Pharmacology reference, where 12.3 comes next.

modes.label: Parenthesis before 12.3
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after the words Clinical Pharmacology, just before 12.3.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward number-like or fragment continuations, but the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and weakly informative.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label's cross-reference where the Clinical Pharmacology section number 12.3 is about to appear.
